elProyecto.title: THE PROJECT
elProyecto.highlight: On the river's edge, a new way of living
elProyecto.body: With over 2,000,000 m² of planned development and more than 200 hectares of natural surroundings, the project offers a private marina, mooring dock, nautical services, WaveTech lagoon with white sand beaches, club house, educational campus, sports area, and commercial spaces.

ubicacion.title: LOCATION
ubicacion.body: Just 20 minutes from the corporate hub of Asunción, in the Northern District, one of the areas with the greatest appreciation potential in Paraguay.

costanera.title: THE WATERFRONT
costanera.highlight: Living by the river turns every view into a privilege
costanera.subtitle: REGATAS SUR NEIGHBORHOOD
costanera.body: Regatas Sur is a premium residential neighborhood designed for those who value exclusivity, nature, and unparalleled views. With riverfront lots, direct access, a 3.9-hectare natural lagoon, marina, and exclusive nautical infrastructure.

barrios.title: Choose where your next story begins
barrios.body: The masterplan includes nine residential neighborhoods, each with its own identity. Navegantes, Veleros and Regatas Sur are the first neighborhoods available to discover and choose today.
descriptions: Consolidated residential sector with nautical lots, connected by the central walkway.
Lots with moorings and direct access to the nautical circuit.
Lots on the inner lagoon with docks and direct views.

paseoCentral.title: CENTRAL WALK
paseoCentral.body: A tree-lined boulevard connecting all neighborhoods. The central walkway is the backbone of the project: commercial spaces, rest areas, and direct access to all amenities.

deportes.title: SPORTS
deportes.body: A complete sports area for all ages. Courts, training spaces, and outdoor recreation areas surrounded by nature.

comercial.title: COMMERCIAL AREA
comercial.body: Shops, school, and everything needed for daily life, integrated within the grounds. Aquadelta's commercial area is designed so you never have to leave the neighborhood for anything.

galeria.title: Everything you imagine, in one place.
galeria.highlight: Discover every space and experience at Aquadelta
